title: Rabbi Elazar bar Berekhyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says that only one statement of his remains, in [Sanhedrin 94b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.94b.8): “A people that wearies itself in Torah is not handed over to its oppressor.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rabbi Elazar bar Berekhyah interpreting a verse in Isaiah during its account of Sennacherib. The statement that only one of his sayings remains is Hyman’s.
